intro:
Two cars. One chain. Total chaos.
Drive, survive, and try not to drag your partner into disaster.
description:
Get ready for a chaotic driving adventure where teamwork means everything!

Drive through massive obstacle-filled tracks across a variety of unique biomes and dangerous locations. From collapsing bridges and deadly traps to crazy jumps and narrow paths, every run is a challenge.

Play solo or with a friend in local split-screen co-op. In Chained Drivers, both vehicles are connected by a chain, meaning every move matters. Pull your partner to safety… or accidentally drag them into disaster!

Looking for a different experience? Try additional game modes without the chain, challenge yourself in hardcore mode with no checkpoints, or relax in Free Drive mode where you can explore the map, hit ramps, perform stunts, and enjoy the satisfying vehicle physics and destruction system.

Watch your truck bend, break apart, lose wheels, and barely survive intense crashes thanks to dynamic vehicle damage and physics-based gameplay.

Every run tracks your completion time, so improve your skills, beat your records, and master every obstacle.

Features:

▶ Local split-screen multiplayer
▶ Unique chained co-op gameplay
▶ Huge obstacle-filled maps
▶ Multiple biomes and locations
▶ Hardcore mode with no checkpoints
▶ Free Drive sandbox mode
▶ Dynamic vehicle damage and destruction
▶ Physics-based driving chaos
▶ Time records and replayability

Can you survive the road together?
